conflict_short: This machine shows several different texts under this number: this is not normal.

waiting_here.one: Waiting for approval on this machine: {versions}. Approve it from your approval device (Settings, Updates): until then, it is not sent anywhere.
waiting_here.other: Waiting for approval on this machine: {versions}. Approve them from your approval device (Settings, Updates): until then, they are not sent anywhere.

title: Approval on a second device
required: Each version must also be approved by an approval device, usually your phone.
not_required: No approval device declared: the author's signature is enough.
create_key_help: On your phone, this button creates its approval key, which never leaves it. Then add the line it shows to aiodos/updates/keys.py.
key_created: Approval key created on this device.
declared: This device approves AIODOS versions. Before approving, check that you are the one who just published.
not_declared: Key created, not declared yet: add this line to APPROVER_KEYS (aiodos/updates/keys.py), commit, then publish.
none_pending: No version is pending on your online machines.
approved: Version {version} approved: it can now go out to your machines.
key_exists: This device already has its approval key.
mine_only: Only my machines can see and approve pending versions.
unknown_version: Unknown version here, or unreadable approval.
conflict: This machine shows several different texts under this number: this is not normal (compromised machine, or stolen publishing key?). Do not approve anything before checking it.
no_key: This device has no approval key.
unknown_machine: Unknown machine, or not one of mine.
several_texts_version: “{name}” showed several different texts under number {version}: there is no telling which one you read, so nothing was signed. This is not normal (compromised machine, or stolen publishing key?): check this machine before approving anything.
several_texts: “{name}” showed several different texts under the same number: there is no telling which one you read, so nothing was signed. This is not normal (compromised machine, or stolen publishing key?): check this machine before approving anything.
show_first: Show the pending versions first: only what you have seen can be approved.
no_longer_waiting: Version {version} is no longer waiting for approval on “{name}”.
changed: Version {version} on “{name}” is no longer the one you were shown: review it before approving it.
